cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read me the subject line of your apology email. It needs to name the vase you broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add the incident, please. The recipient shouldn't have to open an apology to discover what it's for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the first sentence is 'I broke the vase'. Responsibility before regret. Please don't make her infer who did it again.

reason: Use actual copy editing and recipient knowledge to determine apology order; remove the detached font joke.
